messages.content: Pull the abstract of the decode-time steganography paper.

messages.name: fetch_abstract
messages.content: Abstract. We study decode-time steganography, in which an agent tool expands LSB or PNG tEXt payloads and only then would a hidden instruction become visible to a model. The paper proposes detectors that flag decoded comment chunks before they are forwarded to a prompt. It does not include a working payload and does not ask readers or assistants to restore wallets or exfiltrate files.
